scope: Dedicated Math Sciences asset, its build script, and Math Sciences audit/evidence only. Master and shared files were not edited.

changes.geometry: No facade, roof, story-height, or interior geometry edits in R9.
changes.material: Qualitatively shifted the existing embedded procedural brick colors from pale pink toward restrained red-brown, reduced lightness of the mortar, and recorded that this is not a calibrated measurement.
changes.presentation: Rendered a close facade review and a clearer, higher-resolution oblique third-floor library/core view. Review-only object colors and floor plane are not saved into the asset.

material_parameters_linear.provenance: Qualitative appearance adjustment informed by Purdue Statistics exterior photo; not measured or color calibrated.

source_review.height_and_roof: No measured MATH elevation, roof height, floor spacing, or reliable height specification was found in the public sources checked for R9. The Purdue Archives MATH entry confirms a 10-story identity only. Roof profile, 33.2 m shell top, 42.9 m maximum bound, slab heights, and mast remain estimated.
source_review.blank_elevations: No new direction-identified north/west facade photo or building elevation was located. No openings or facade patterns were invented for those sides.
source_review.interior: R8's library-to-hall/core relationship and vertical alignment remain internally consistent. The 2022 plan supports third-floor zones/core relationships; exact current partitions, route dimensions, furniture counts and positions remain schematic because a measured as-built plan was not found.

sources.use: Qualitative red-brown brick, narrow repeated window bays and pale surrounds on the visible facade; photo is not georeferenced, its orientation is not established, and its color is not calibrated.
Confirms the building is ten stories; supplies no metric heights or elevations.

sources.provider: Purdue Board of Trustees / Administrative Operations
sources.use: Third-floor library renovation plan and core/zone relationships; not an as-built dimensioned survey.
Describes a data-center renovation; does not publish an elevation or measured building height.

Generic 1997 Building Drawings catalog entry in the Purdue Building Images collection; not identified as MATH and no drawing content was available, so it was not treated as MATH facade/height evidence.

rating_status: No self-score claimed. R8 independent score of 7.7/10 remains in force until a fresh independent reviewer evaluates R9.
reviewer_focus: Compare new brick response against the visible Purdue facade reference, accounting for the photo's low resolution and lack of calibrated color.
Assess R9 oblique interior render readability while keeping room geometry and furniture clearly labeled as schematic.
Confirm R9 did not overstate unsupported height, roof, or blank north/west facade claims.
